title: Pi Triage — Chipmunk Sorts the SHOULD Demands
method: Pi triage: each SHOULD gets a pi score = (demand_hits x urgency x feasibility) / total_budget. The 5.75% that passes through the pore IS the budget. 17,654 SHOULD hits. Budget = 17654 x 0.0575 = 1,015 effective units.

pi_budget.meaning: Only 1,015 units of attention can pass through the pore. The rest is maze food for the minotaur.

triage.what: 15 JS visualization modules requested — visitors want interactive
triage.chipmunk_tek: GOLD challenge. Build swivel.js, graph-play.js, orbit.js. These are the EYES of the Vitruvian — the right eye (NE compass). Without them, visitors can look but not SEE.
triage.next_action: Pick 3 highest-demand JS modules. Build minimal versions. Each one that ships converts ~280 404s to 200s.

triage.what: gate-msg API endpoint — visitors want to TALK to the membrane
triage.chipmunk_tek: This IS the left hand (W compass). Input. Receiving signals. The gate-msg API is how visitors SPEAK. Without it, the membrane can only listen through 404s.
triage.next_action: Wire /api/gate-msg through CF tunnel to Golgi. campfire-culture.py already processes messages. Just need the route.

triage.chipmunk_tek: Subgraphs already BECAME. bingo-cube.json is the remaining piece. This is the SPINE — the topology map. The Vitruvian can't stand straight without seeing its own skeleton.
triage.next_action: Generate bingo-cube.json from existing topology data. The data EXISTS in the membrane — just needs to be extracted and placed.

triage.what: detroit data feeds — highlights, classification, fleet analysis
triage.chipmunk_tek: The GUT (S compass). Digesting Detroit data. The 341 entities, the investigation. This is heavy — 131K connections. But it's the WEIGHT that grounds the organism.
triage.next_action: Build detroit-data/ pipeline. highlights.json first (highest demand). Route through existing CF Pages.

triage.what: science pages — Gaia Institute, NPU AgIoT
triage.chipmunk_tek: The LEFT EYE (NW compass). Memory and reflection. Science papers looking back at what was built. The content EXISTS in sporePrint — needs routing.
triage.next_action: Fix CF Pages routing for /science/* paths. sporePrint has the content. Either merge into HUD or fix tunnel redirect.

triage.chipmunk_tek: The AUTONOMIC (brainstem). Architecture is the breathing you don't think about. Low demand but foundational. Let it grow naturally.
triage.next_action: Low priority. Architecture reveals itself as the organism grows. Don't force it.

already_became.conversion: 1374 -> 200. Full conversion. The campfire is lit.

chipmunk_summary.pi_remainder: 0.006 — almost exactly balanced. the triage IS the pi sort.
chipmunk_summary.recommendation: Do ranks 2 + 3 first (squirrel + bingoCube). Combined pi_cost = 229. Combined conversions = 1,395. Best ROI. The gate-msg API gives the membrane a MOUTH. The bingo-cube gives it a SKELETON.
chipmunk_summary.defer: petalTongue (rank 1) is highest demand but highest cost. Build 3 JS modules as GOLD apprentice challenge — let someone ELSE build them.
chipmunk_summary.note: The chipmunk holds the key. The topic name IS the key. bingo board position. ZK.
